title: Nda Msa
description: Nda Msa contract normalized from the DocuBricks Legal library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-legal-nda-msa
  title: Nda Msa
  description: Nda Msa contract normalized from the DocuBricks Legal library.
  version: legal_nda_msa_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: legal/nda_msa
    sourcePath: Schemas/legal/nda_msa
    sourceVersion: legal_nda_msa_v1
    sourceDigest: ab8f50dd539d346f33e0f1d3dfcc4926973e036350d12869b143cff112021454
spec:
  documentType: nda_msa
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - amendment-number
        - confidentiality-period-years
        - effective-date
        - expiration-date
        - liquidated-damages-amount
        - renewal-notice-days
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - agreement-type
        - arbitration-clause
        - arbitration-venue
        - auto-renew
        - confidentiality-scope
        - excluded-information
        - governing-law
        - non-compete-clause
        - non-solicitation-clause
        - permitted-uses
        - return-or-destroy-obligation
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - party-1-name
        - party-1-role
        - party-1-state
        - party-2-name
        - party-2-role
        - party-2-state
  fields:
    - id: agreement-type
      name: agreement_type
      label: Agreement Type
      description: "Classification of the agreement. One of: NDA | MSA | MNDA | MOU | LOI | Other"
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/agreement_type
    - id: effective-date
      name: effective_date
      label: Effective Date
      description: The date the agreement becomes effective, format YYYY-MM-DD
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/effective_date
    - id: expiration-date
      name: expiration_date
      label: Expiration Date
      description: The date the agreement expires or terminates, format YYYY-MM-DD (null if perpetual or not stated)
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/expiration_date
    - id: auto-renew
      name: auto_renew
      label: Auto Renew
      description: Boolean — true if the agreement contains an automatic renewal clause
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/auto_renew
    - id: renewal-notice-days
      name: renewal_notice_days
      label: Renewal Notice Days
      description: Number of days' advance notice required to prevent auto-renewal, as integer (null if not applicable)
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/renewal_notice_days
    - id: amendment-number
      name: amendment_number
      label: Amendment Number
      description: If this document is an amendment or addendum, the amendment number as integer (e.g., 1 for
        "Amendment No. 1"; null if original agreement)
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/amendment_number
    - id: party-1-name
      name: party_1_name
      label: Party 1 Name
      description: Full legal name of the first party
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/party_1_name
    - id: party-1-role
      name: party_1_role
      label: Party 1 Role
      description: "Role of the first party. One of: Disclosing | Receiving | Both (for mutual agreements)"
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/party_1_role
    - id: party-1-state
      name: party_1_state
      label: Party 1 State
      description: State or jurisdiction of incorporation/organization for party 1 (two-letter state code or country
        if non-US)
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/party_1_state
    - id: party-2-name
      name: party_2_name
      label: Party 2 Name
      description: Full legal name of the second party
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/party_2_name
    - id: party-2-role
      name: party_2_role
      label: Party 2 Role
      description: "Role of the second party. One of: Disclosing | Receiving | Both"
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/party_2_role
    - id: party-2-state
      name: party_2_state
      label: Party 2 State
      description: State or jurisdiction of incorporation/organization for party 2
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/party_2_state
    - id: governing-law
      name: governing_law
      label: Governing Law
      description: The state or jurisdiction whose laws govern the agreement (e.g., "CA", "NY", "DE", "England and Wales")
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/governing_law
    - id: confidentiality-period-years
      name: confidentiality_period_years
      label: Confidentiality Period Years
      description: Duration of the confidentiality obligation in years as decimal (null if perpetual or not
        explicitly stated in years)
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/confidentiality_period_years
    - id: confidentiality-scope
      name: confidentiality_scope
      label: Confidentiality Scope
      description: Brief description of what information is deemed confidential (up to 200 chars)
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/confidentiality_scope
    - id: permitted-uses
      name: permitted_uses
      label: Permitted Uses
      description: Array of strings describing the permitted uses of confidential information (e.g., ["Evaluating
        potential business relationship", "Performing services under the MSA"])
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/permitted_uses
    - id: excluded-information
      name: excluded_information
      label: Excluded Information
      description: Array of strings listing categories of information excluded from confidentiality obligations
        (e.g., ["Publicly available information", "Independently developed information", "Information received
        from third parties without restriction"])
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/excluded_information
    - id: return-or-destroy-obligation
      name: return_or_destroy_obligation
      label: Return Or Destroy Obligation
      description: Boolean — true if the agreement requires return or destruction of confidential materials upon
        termination or request
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/return_or_destroy_obligation
    - id: non-solicitation-clause
      name: non_solicitation_clause
      label: Non Solicitation Clause
      description: Boolean — true if the agreement contains a non-solicitation clause restricting hiring of the
        other party's employees
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/non_solicitation_clause
    - id: non-compete-clause
      name: non_compete_clause
      label: Non Compete Clause
      description: Boolean — true if the agreement contains a non-compete or non-competition clause
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/non_compete_clause
    - id: liquidated-damages-amount
      name: liquidated_damages_amount
      label: Liquidated Damages Amount
      description: The liquidated damages amount stated in the agreement as decimal (null if not specified)
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/liquidated_damages_amount
    - id: arbitration-clause
      name: arbitration_clause
      label: Arbitration Clause
      description: Boolean — true if the agreement requires disputes to be resolved by arbitration
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/arbitration_clause
    - id: arbitration-venue
      name: arbitration_venue
      label: Arbitration Venue
      description: City and/or state where arbitration proceedings would be held (null if no arbitration clause)
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/arbitration_venue
  validationRules:
    - id: document-id-present
      severity: error
      description: Every extracted record must carry a document_id — system invariant required for lineage tracking,
        audit trail, and deduplication
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: document_id
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: document_id
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: document_id IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(document_id)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: avg-confidence-acceptable
      severity: warning
      description: Overall extraction confidence below 0.70 indicates the document is likely illegible, heavily
        redacted, or in an unsupported format; route to quarantine for human review
      rule:
        op: gte
        left:
          field: avg_confidence
        right:
          value: 0.7
      sourceExpression: avg_confidence >= 0.70
      supported: true
    - id: agreement-type-valid-enum
      severity: warning
      description: Agreement type must be a recognized enumeration; invalid values break downstream routing to the
        correct contract management workflow
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: agreement_type
            right:
              value: NDA
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: agreement_type
            right:
              value: MSA
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: agreement_type
            right:
              value: MNDA
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: agreement_type
            right:
              value: MOU
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: agreement_type
            right:
              value: LOI
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: agreement_type
            right:
              value: Other
      sourceExpression: agreement_type IN ('NDA', 'MSA', 'MNDA', 'MOU', 'LOI', 'Other')
      supported: true
    - id: effective-date-not-null
      severity: warning
      description: Effective date is essential for contract lifecycle management, renewal monitoring, and obligation
        tracking; records without it cannot be reliably managed
      rule:
        op: present
        field: effective_date
      sourceExpression: effective_date IS NOT NULL
      supported: true
    - id: governing-law-present
      severity: warning
      description: Governing law determines which jurisdiction's rules apply to dispute resolution and enforcement;
        absence triggers legal review
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: governing_law
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: governing_law
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: governing_law IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(governing_law)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: expiration-date-logical
      severity: warning
      description: Expiration date must be after effective date if both are present; inversion indicates a date
        extraction error
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: expiration_date
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: effective_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              field: expiration_date
            right:
              field: effective_date
      sourceExpression: expiration_date IS NULL OR effective_date IS NULL OR expiration_date > effective_date
      supported: true
    - id: renewal-notice-days-positive
      severity: warning
      description: Renewal notice period must be a positive integer if present; zero or negative values indicate an
        extraction or data entry error
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: renewal_notice_days
          - op: gt
            left:
              field: renewal_notice_days
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: renewal_notice_days IS NULL OR renewal_notice_days > 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      effective_date:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Effective date is the anchor for all obligation timelines and renewal monitoring; date accuracy is
          critical — even a one-day error can affect renewal notice windows
      expiration_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Expiration date drives renewal monitoring and auto-renewal notifications; must be extracted
          accurately to prevent inadvertent obligations
      governing_law:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Governing law determines which jurisdiction's rules apply to disputes, enforcement, and permissible
          confidentiality provisions; errors affect legal risk assessment
      confidentiality_period_years:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Confidentiality duration is a key obligation metric; inaccurate extraction could cause premature
          disclosure or over-restriction of information
      agreement_type:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Agreement type drives routing to the correct contract management workflow and reporting categories
      party_1_name:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Party identity is essential for counterparty risk management, OFAC screening, and vendor onboarding
      party_2_name:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Party identity is essential for counterparty risk management, OFAC screening, and vendor onboarding
      auto_renew:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Auto-renewal status directly affects whether a renewal notice must be sent; false negatives can
          result in unwanted contract extensions
      arbitration_clause:
        minConfidence: 0.82
        reviewOnBreach: false
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Presence of arbitration clause determines dispute resolution path; errors affect litigation strategy
      non_solicitation_clause:
        minConfidence: 0.82
        reviewOnBreach: false
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Non-solicitation status must be tracked for HR and talent acquisition compliance; errors create
          legal exposure
      non_compete_clause:
        minConfidence: 0.82
        reviewOnBreach: false
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Non-compete obligations are legally sensitive; accuracy required to inform business development and
          hiring decisions
      return_or_destroy_obligation:
        minConfidence: 0.8
        reviewOnBreach: false
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Return/destroy obligation triggers an actionable process upon contract termination; errors cause
          data governance failures
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-claude-haiku
    maxTokens: 8192
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: NDA and MSA documents require nuanced legal reasoning to correctly interpret confidentiality scope,
      restrictive covenants, governing law provisions, and auto-renewal mechanics. Clause language is often
      dense, cross-referential, and deliberately ambiguous. Claude Sonnet is preferred for its strong legal
      reasoning, ability to track multi-party obligations across long documents, and accurate boolean
      extraction (e.g., non-solicitation, arbitration clause). The higher token budget (8192) accommodates
      MSAs that embed multiple exhibits, schedules, and addenda within a single document. Temperature 0.0
      ensures deterministic, reproducible extractions required for contract management audit trails. Claude
      Haiku is retained as fallback for straightforward short-form NDAs where extraction latency matters more
      than deep reasoning.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      agreement_type:
        type: string
        description: "Classification of the agreement. One of: NDA | MSA | MNDA | MOU | LOI | Other"
      effective_date:
        type: date
        description: The date the agreement becomes effective, format YYYY-MM-DD
        format: date
      expiration_date:
        type: date
        description: The date the agreement expires or terminates, format YYYY-MM-DD (null if perpetual or not stated)
        format: date
      auto_renew:
        type: boolean
        description: Boolean — true if the agreement contains an automatic renewal clause
      renewal_notice_days:
        type: string
        description: Number of days' advance notice required to prevent auto-renewal, as integer (null if not applicable)
      amendment_number:
        type: string
        description: If this document is an amendment or addendum, the amendment number as integer (e.g., 1 for
          "Amendment No. 1"; null if original agreement)
      party_1_name:
        type: string
        description: Full legal name of the first party
      party_1_role:
        type: string
        description: "Role of the first party. One of: Disclosing | Receiving | Both (for mutual agreements)"
      party_1_state:
        type: string
        description: State or jurisdiction of incorporation/organization for party 1 (two-letter state code or country
          if non-US)
      party_2_name:
        type: string
        description: Full legal name of the second party
      party_2_role:
        type: string
        description: "Role of the second party. One of: Disclosing | Receiving | Both"
      party_2_state:
        type: string
        description: State or jurisdiction of incorporation/organization for party 2
      governing_law:
        type: string
        description: The state or jurisdiction whose laws govern the agreement (e.g., "CA", "NY", "DE", "England and
          Wales")
      confidentiality_period_years:
        type: string
        description: Duration of the confidentiality obligation in years as decimal (null if perpetual or not
          explicitly stated in years)
      confidentiality_scope:
        type: string
        description: Brief description of what information is deemed confidential (up to 200 chars)
      permitted_uses:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Array of strings describing the permitted uses of confidential information (e.g., ["Evaluating
          potential business relationship", "Performing services under the MSA"])
      excluded_information:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Array of strings listing categories of information excluded from confidentiality obligations
          (e.g., ["Publicly available information", "Independently developed information", "Information
          received from third parties without restriction"])
      return_or_destroy_obligation:
        type: string
        description: Boolean — true if the agreement requires return or destruction of confidential materials upon
          termination or request
      non_solicitation_clause:
        type: boolean
        description: Boolean — true if the agreement contains a non-solicitation clause restricting hiring of the
          other party's employees
      non_compete_clause:
        type: boolean
        description: Boolean — true if the agreement contains a non-compete or non-competition clause
      liquidated_damages_amount:
        type: number
        description: The liquidated damages amount stated in the agreement as decimal (null if not specified)
      arbitration_clause:
        type: boolean
        description: Boolean — true if the agreement requires disputes to be resolved by arbitration
      arbitration_venue:
        type: number
        description: City and/or state where arbitration proceedings would be held (null if no arbitration clause)
    required:
      - effective_date
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: contracts
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - effective_date
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - parties
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields: []
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
